text: {"rules":[{"id":"DTAP-4-BY-AGE-2","version":"cdc_child (edition year not stated in section)","title":"DTaP primary series plus first booster (4 doses) by age 2","source_quote":"5-dose series (3-dose primary series at age 2, 4, and 6 months,","grade":"ACIP routine recommendation (no USPSTF letter grade)","effective_date":"not stated in section","action":"Administer DTaP doses 1-3 at ages 2, 4 and 6 months and dose 4 (booster) at 15-18 months","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 2, \"max\": 2, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"booster doses at ages 15–18 months\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"the 4th dose (first booster) is due by 18 months, so children turning 2 in the measurement year should have completed it\", \"max\": \"cohort restricted to children turning 2 in the measurement year, the first whole-year age after the 15-18 month booster\"}}","numerator":"{\"immunization\": {\"concept\": \"dtap_vaccine\", \"min_count\": 4, \"window\": [\"{MY-2}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"3-dose primary series at age 2, 4, and 6 months,\", \"derived\": {\"min_count\": \"3 primary doses plus the booster due at 15-18 months gives 4 doses expected by age 2\", \"window\": \"a child aged 2 at end of measurement year was born no earlier than {MY-2}-01-01, so this window covers all doses since birth\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Only the first 4 doses of the routine 5-dose DTaP series are encoded (expected by age 2, derived; rule goes to human review). The numerator window runs to {MY}-12-31, so it can credit doses given after the 2nd birthday; it does not restrict to doses given before the birthday.","Dose 5 at age 4-6 years is not encoded as a rule. 'Dose 5 is not necessary if dose 4 was administered at age 4 years or older and at least 6 months after dose 3' depends on dose dates relative to birth and to prior doses. This cannot be expressed in the grammar, and omitting it would falsely flag compliant children.","Minimum age 6 weeks (4 years for Kinrix or Quadracel) for valid doses is not enforced. Product choice (Kinrix/Quadracel) is not represented.","Minimum intervals are not represented: prospective dose 4 as early as 12 months if at least 6 months since dose 3; retrospective counting of an early dose 4 if at least 4 months since dose 3.","Catch-up guidance (Table 2) is not represented.","Special situation not represented: Td may replace DTaP for remaining doses in children younger than 7 years with a pertussis-specific contraindication (encephalopathy within 7 days of vaccination not attributable to another cause). Td doses are not credited and these children are not excluded.","Wound management is not represented: DTaP for non-clean/non-minor wounds if more than 5 years since the last tetanus-toxoid dose, in children younger than 7 years with 3 or more prior doses. This depends on injury events and clinician judgment.","No exclusions (e.g., deceased, contraindication) are stated in the section, so none are encoded."]}
